latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Content Repurposing Engine.
- Repurpose any long-form content into platform-specific posts for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Email, Instagram, and Blog/DEV.to.
- Detailed framework includes source content audit, platform selection matrix, and platform-specific transformation prompts.
- Ready-to-use prompt templates and formatting rules for each supported platform.
- Includes a 30-day content calendar plan for maximum leverage from a single source.
- Emphasizes quality standards and common pitfalls to avoid when repurposing content.
